grammarNoteTr: at the scene (olay yerinde), behind the scenes (perde arkasında)

senses.label: part of a film or place
senses.definitionEn: a short part of a film or play, or the place where something happens

examples.en: My favourite scene is when the two brothers finally meet.
examples.tr: En sevdiğim sahne, iki kardeşin sonunda buluştuğu an.

examples.en: The police arrived at the scene within ten minutes.
examples.tr: Polis on dakika içinde olay yerine vardı.

examples.en: The actors rehearsed the last scenes again before the show.
examples.tr: Oyuncular gösteriden önce son sahneleri tekrar prova etti.

commonMistakesTr: scheme kelimesini 'şema' (diagram) sanmak: 'şema' için diagram veya chart kullanılır.

senses.label: official plan
senses.definitionEn: an official plan or system for doing something or giving people help

examples.en: The city started a new scheme to encourage cycling.
examples.tr: Şehir, bisiklet kullanımını teşvik etmek için yeni bir program başlattı.

examples.en: All staff can join the company pension scheme.
examples.tr: Tüm çalışanlar şirketin emeklilik planına katılabilir.

examples.en: They planned a clever scheme to win the competition.
examples.tr: Yarışmayı kazanmak için akıllıca bir plan kurdular.

senses.label: expert who studies
senses.definitionEn: a person who studies a subject in great detail, especially at a university

examples.en: She is a respected scholar of ancient history.
examples.tr: O, antik tarih alanında saygın bir akademisyendir.

examples.en: Scholars still disagree about the meaning of the poem.
examples.tr: Akademisyenler şiirin anlamı konusunda hâlâ anlaşamıyor.

examples.en: The library attracts scholars from all over the world.
examples.tr: Kütüphane dünyanın her yerinden araştırmacıları çekiyor.

senses.label: money for study
senses.definitionEn: money given to a student to help pay for their education

examples.en: He won a scholarship to study engineering in Canada.
examples.tr: Kanada'da mühendislik okumak için burs kazandı.

examples.en: Are you going to apply for a scholarship this year?
examples.tr: Bu yıl bir burs için başvuracak mısın?

examples.en: Without a full scholarship, I couldn't afford university.
examples.tr: Tam burs olmadan üniversiteye gücüm yetmezdi.

grammarNoteTr: sayılamaz isim: 'a science' denmez (bilim dalı anlamı hariç)

senses.label: study of nature
senses.definitionEn: the study of the natural world through observation and experiments

examples.en: Science is my favourite subject at school.
Our science teacher showed us how plants grow.
examples.tr: Fen öğretmenimiz bitkilerin nasıl büyüdüğünü bize gösterdi.

examples.en: Do you like reading science fiction?

senses.label: related to science
senses.definitionEn: connected with science or using its careful methods

examples.en: There is strong scientific evidence for climate change.
examples.tr: İklim değişikliği için güçlü bilimsel kanıt var.

examples.en: The museum has a large collection of scientific instruments.
examples.tr: Müzede büyük bir bilimsel alet koleksiyonu var.

examples.en: His method is not very scientific, but it works.
examples.tr: Yöntemi pek bilimsel değil ama işe yarıyor.

senses.label: person who does science
senses.definitionEn: a person who studies or works in one of the natural sciences

examples.en: My sister wants to become a scientist.
examples.tr: Kız kardeşim bilim insanı olmak istiyor.

examples.en: Scientists have found a new kind of frog in the rainforest.
examples.tr: Bilim insanları yağmur ormanında yeni bir kurbağa türü buldu.

examples.en: A team of scientists is studying the ocean floor.
examples.tr: Bir bilim insanı ekibi okyanus tabanını inceliyor.

senses.label: small metal fixer
senses.definitionEn: a thin pointed piece of metal that you turn to hold things together

examples.en: One of the screws on my glasses is loose.
You need a small screwdriver to tighten this screw.
examples.tr: Bu vidayı sıkmak için küçük bir tornavida gerekiyor.

examples.en: He put four screws into the wall to hold the shelf.
examples.tr: Rafı tutması için duvara dört vida taktı.

senses.label: turn to fix
senses.definitionEn: to fasten something by turning it or by using these metal pieces

examples.en: Screw the lid on tightly so the juice doesn't spill.
examples.tr: Meyve suyu dökülmesin diye kapağı sıkıca çevirerek kapat.

examples.en: They screwed the sign to the front door.

senses.label: written words of a film
senses.definitionEn: the written text of a film, play, speech or computer program

examples.en: The actors received the script two weeks before filming.
examples.tr: Oyuncular senaryoyu çekimden iki hafta önce aldı.

examples.en: She wrote a short script to automate the reports.
examples.tr: Raporları otomatikleştirmek için kısa bir betik yazdı.

examples.en: Call centre staff often have to follow a script.
examples.tr: Çağrı merkezi çalışanları genellikle bir metne bağlı kalmak zorunda.
examples.noteTr: follow a script: hazır metni takip etmek.

grammarNoteTr: in + season: in summer, in the winter season

senses.label: part of the year
senses.definitionEn: one of the four parts of the year, or a period when something usually happens

examples.en: Autumn is my favourite season.
Hotels are very expensive during the holiday season.
Strawberries taste best when they are in season.

commonMistakesTr: 'Yer boş mu?' için 'Is this place empty?' yerine doğal olan 'Is this seat free/taken?' kalıbıdır.

senses.label: place to sit
senses.definitionEn: something you sit on, especially in a car, bus, theatre or plane

examples.en: Please take a seat, the doctor will see you soon.
examples.tr: Lütfen oturun, doktor sizi birazdan görecek.

examples.en: I always ask for a window seat on the plane.
examples.tr: Uçakta hep cam kenarı koltuk isterim.

examples.en: Excuse me, is this seat free?

senses.label: second level or less important
senses.definitionEn: less important than something else, or relating to school for children aged about 11 to 18

examples.en: My brother is a teacher at a secondary school.
For him, money is of secondary importance.
The infection caused some secondary problems.
examples.tr: Enfeksiyon bazı ikincil sorunlara yol açtı.

senses.label: hidden information
senses.definitionEn: a piece of information that you do not tell other people

examples.en: Can you keep a secret?
She told me a secret about her new job.
examples.tr: Yeni işiyle ilgili bana bir sır söyledi.

examples.en: What is the secret of your delicious soup?

senses.label: not known by others
senses.definitionEn: known by only a few people and hidden from others

examples.en: They had a secret meeting after work.
examples.tr: İşten sonra gizli bir toplantı yaptılar.

examples.en: The children found a secret path behind the garden.
examples.tr: Çocuklar bahçenin arkasında gizli bir yol buldu.

senses.label: office assistant
senses.definitionEn: a person who works in an office typing letters, answering calls and arranging meetings

examples.en: The secretary will give you an appointment for Monday.
examples.tr: Sekreter size pazartesi için randevu verecek.

examples.en: Please leave a message with my secretary.
She worked as a secretary before she became a manager.
examples.tr: Müdür olmadan önce sekreter olarak çalıştı.

senses.label: one part of something
senses.definitionEn: one of the parts that something is divided into

examples.en: Read the first section of the report before the meeting.
examples.tr: Toplantıdan önce raporun ilk bölümünü okuyun.

examples.en: My dad always reads the sports section first.
examples.tr: Babam her zaman önce spor sayfasını okur.

examples.en: This section of the motorway is closed for repairs.
examples.tr: Otoyolun bu kısmı onarım için kapalı.

senses.label: part of the economy
senses.definitionEn: a part of a country's economy or business activity

examples.en: She left the public sector to work for a private company.
examples.tr: Özel bir şirkette çalışmak için kamu sektöründen ayrıldı.

examples.en: Tourism is the largest sector of the local economy.
examples.tr: Turizm yerel ekonominin en büyük sektörü.

examples.en: Jobs in the technology sector are growing quickly.

senses.label: plant starts from it
senses.definitionEn: a small hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows

examples.en: We planted tomato seeds in small pots.
I love eating sunflower seeds while watching football.
examples.tr: Futbol izlerken ay çekirdeği yemeyi çok severim.

examples.en: Does this watermelon have any seeds?

senses.label: choosing or range
senses.definitionEn: the act of choosing, or a group of things that you can choose from

examples.en: The shop has a wide selection of teas.
examples.noteTr: a wide selection of: geniş bir ... çeşidi.

examples.en: The selection process for the job took three months.
examples.tr: İş için seçim süreci üç ay sürdü.

examples.en: Here is a selection of photos from our trip.

grammarNoteTr: çoğulu: selves; dönüşlü zamirlerde: myself, yourself

senses.label: who you really are
senses.definitionEn: the type of person you are, especially your real character

examples.en: After the holiday, she was back to her old self.
examples.noteTr: back to your old self: eski haline dönmek.

examples.en: It's important to be your true self with friends.
examples.tr: Arkadaşların yanında gerçek kendin olmak önemli.

examples.en: Children slowly develop a sense of self.
examples.tr: Çocuklar yavaş yavaş bir benlik duygusu geliştirir.

grammarNoteTr: sell - sold - sold; sell something to someone

senses.label: give for money
senses.definitionEn: to give something to someone in exchange for money

examples.en: We sold our old car last week.
Does this shop sell batteries?
The concert tickets sold out in an hour.

senses.label: person who sells
senses.definitionEn: a person or company that offers something for money

examples.en: The seller agreed to lower the price.
Her first novel became a best seller.
examples.tr: İlk romanı en çok satanlar arasına girdi.

examples.en: Always check reviews of the seller before you buy online.
examples.tr: İnternetten almadan önce satıcının yorumlarını mutlaka kontrol et.

senses.label: higher rank or older
senses.definitionEn: having a higher position or more experience than others, or older

examples.en: She was promoted to senior designer last year.
examples.tr: Geçen yıl kıdemli tasarımcılığa terfi etti.

examples.en: Senior citizens can travel free on city buses.
examples.tr: Yaşlı vatandaşlar şehir otobüslerinde ücretsiz seyahat edebilir.

examples.en: I need to speak to someone more senior.
examples.tr: Daha üst düzey biriyle konuşmam gerekiyor.

senses.label: connected order
senses.definitionEn: a series of things that follow each other in a particular order

examples.en: Put the pictures in the correct sequence.
A strange sequence of events led to the accident.
examples.tr: Garip bir olaylar silsilesi kazaya yol açtı.

examples.en: The opening sequence of the film is amazing.

commonMistakesTr: Çoğul için 'serieses' veya tekil için 'serie' demek; her ikisi de 'series'tir.

senses.label: set of related things
senses.definitionEn: several things of the same kind that come one after another, or a TV programme with many episodes

examples.en: Have you watched the new crime series yet?
The museum is hosting a series of talks on art.
examples.tr: Müze sanat üzerine bir dizi konuşmaya ev sahipliği yapıyor.

examples.en: Both series were filmed in Istanbul.
examples.tr: Her iki dizi de İstanbul'da çekildi.

senses.label: end a disagreement
senses.definitionEn: to end an argument or problem by agreeing on something

examples.en: They finally settled the argument over dinner.
Let's settle this quickly and get back to work.
The two companies settled out of court.
examples.noteTr: settle out of court: mahkeme dışında uzlaşmak.

senses.label: start living somewhere
senses.definitionEn: to go and live in a place and stay there

examples.en: My grandparents settled in Izmir after they retired.
examples.tr: Dedemle ninem emekli olduktan sonra İzmir'e yerleşti.

examples.en: He wants to settle down and start a family.
examples.tr: Yerleşik bir düzen kurup aile sahibi olmak istiyor.

senses.label: the number 7
senses.definitionEn: the number that comes after six and before eight

examples.en: There are seven days in a week.
I usually wake up at seven o'clock.
My little brother is seven years old.

commonMistakesTr: sew (/soʊ/, dikmek) ile sow (tohum ekmek) ve saw (görmek'in geçmişi) karıştırılır.

senses.label: join with needle and thread
senses.definitionEn: to join pieces of cloth or attach something using a needle and thread

examples.en: Can you sew this button back on my coat?
examples.tr: Bu düğmeyi montuma tekrar dikebilir misin?
examples.noteTr: sew something on: bir şeyi dikip takmak.

examples.en: My grandmother sewed all her own dresses.
I learned to sew at a summer course.
examples.tr: Dikiş dikmeyi bir yaz kursunda öğrendim.

commonMistakesTr: Güneşten korunulan alan için 'shadow' demek: 'gölgede otur' = sit in the shade (shadow değil).

senses.label: area out of the sun
senses.definitionEn: an area that is darker and cooler because the sun cannot reach it

examples.en: Let's sit in the shade under that tree.
It was too hot, so the dog stayed in the shade.
examples.tr: Hava çok sıcaktı, bu yüzden köpek gölgede kaldı.

examples.en: There isn't much shade on this beach.

senses.label: type of a colour
senses.definitionEn: a slightly different form of a colour

examples.en: I want to paint the room a lighter shade of green.
examples.tr: Odayı daha açık bir yeşil tonuna boyamak istiyorum.

examples.en: This lipstick comes in five different shades.
examples.tr: Bu ruj beş farklı tonda geliyor.

senses.label: dark shape from light
senses.definitionEn: a dark shape that appears when something blocks the light

examples.en: In the evening our shadows become very long.
The child was scared of his own shadow.
examples.noteTr: be scared of your own shadow: çok ürkek olmak.

examples.en: The tall building casts a shadow over the park.

senses.label: move quickly up and down
senses.definitionEn: to move something quickly from side to side or up and down

examples.en: Shake the bottle well before you open it.
They shook hands and started the meeting.
examples.noteTr: shake - shook - shaken; shake hands: tokalaşmak.

examples.en: Her hands were shaking before the exam.
He shook his head when I asked him.
examples.tr: Ona sorduğumda başını iki yana salladı.
examples.noteTr: shake your head: hayır anlamında başını sallamak.

grammarNoteTr: Shall + fiil yalın hali (to yok); çoğunlukla I/we ile soru

senses.label: offer or suggestion
senses.definitionEn: used in questions with I or we to offer help or make a suggestion

examples.en: Shall I open the window for you?
Shall we go for a walk after lunch?
examples.tr: Öğle yemeğinden sonra yürüyüşe çıkalım mı?

examples.en: What shall we cook tonight?

senses.label: not deep
senses.definitionEn: having only a short distance from the top to the bottom

examples.en: The children played in the shallow water near the beach.
examples.tr: Çocuklar plajın yakınındaki sığ suda oynadı.

examples.en: The river is too shallow for big boats.
examples.tr: Nehir büyük tekneler için fazla sığ.

examples.en: I think his ideas are a bit shallow.

senses.label: pity or bad feeling
senses.definitionEn: a bad feeling after doing something wrong, or a situation that makes you feel sorry

examples.en: What a shame you can't come to the party!
It's a shame that the café closed.
He felt deep shame after lying to his parents.
examples.tr: Ailesine yalan söyledikten sonra derin bir utanç duydu.

senses.label: outer form
senses.definitionEn: the form of the outside edges of something, like a circle or square

examples.en: The cake was in the shape of a heart.
What shape is the table, round or square?
examples.tr: Masa ne şekilde, yuvarlak mı kare mi?

examples.en: I go running every day to stay in shape.
examples.tr: Formda kalmak için her gün koşuya çıkıyorum.

senses.label: able to cut
senses.definitionEn: having a thin edge or point that can cut easily

examples.en: Be careful, that knife is very sharp.
examples.tr: Dikkat et, o bıçak çok keskin.

examples.en: The cat has sharp claws.
I felt a sharp pain in my back.

senses.label: exact time
senses.definitionEn: used after a time to mean exactly at that time

examples.en: The meeting starts at nine o'clock sharp.
Please be here at six sharp.

senses.label: suddenly and a lot
senses.definitionEn: suddenly and by a large amount, or in an angry way

examples.en: Prices rose sharply after the storm.
examples.tr: Fırtınadan sonra fiyatlar keskin bir şekilde arttı.

examples.en: The road turns sharply to the left.
examples.tr: Yol aniden sola keskin bir dönüş yapıyor.

examples.en: She spoke sharply to the noisy students.

senses.label: cut hair from skin
senses.definitionEn: to cut hair from your face or body with a razor

examples.en: My dad shaves every morning before work.
examples.tr: Babam her sabah işten önce tıraş olur.
examples.noteTr: shave: kendi kendine tıraş olmak (myself gerekmez).

examples.en: He decided to shave off his beard.
I didn't have time to shave today.

senses.label: farm animal with wool
senses.definitionEn: a farm animal with thick wool that people keep for meat and wool

examples.en: The farmer has about two hundred sheep.
examples.tr: Çiftçinin yaklaşık iki yüz koyunu var.

examples.en: A sheep was standing in the middle of the road.
When I can't sleep, I count sheep.

senses.label: piece of paper
senses.definitionEn: a flat thin piece of paper, metal or glass

examples.en: Take a sheet of paper and write your name.
examples.tr: Bir kağıt al ve adını yaz.
examples.noteTr: a sheet of paper: bir yaprak kağıt.

examples.en: The teacher gave us a sheet with ten questions.
examples.tr: Öğretmen bize on soruluk bir kağıt verdi.

examples.en: Fill in the answer sheet with a pencil.

senses.label: bed cloth
senses.definitionEn: a large piece of cloth that you put on a bed

examples.en: I change the sheets every Sunday.
The hotel sheets were clean and soft.

senses.label: flat board for storage
senses.definitionEn: a flat board fixed to a wall or in a cupboard for putting things on

examples.en: The salt is on the top shelf.
We need more shelves for all these books.
examples.tr: Bütün bu kitaplar için daha fazla rafa ihtiyacımız var.

examples.en: Can you reach that shelf for me?
examples.tr: Şu rafa benim için uzanabilir misin?

senses.label: hard outer cover
senses.definitionEn: the hard outer part of an egg, nut, or some animals like snails

examples.en: The kids collected shells on the beach.
Be careful, there's a piece of shell in my omelette.
examples.tr: Dikkat et, omletimde bir parça kabuk var.

examples.en: A turtle can hide inside its shell.

senses.label: place of protection
senses.definitionEn: a place that protects you from bad weather or danger

examples.en: We took shelter from the rain under a bridge.
examples.tr: Yağmurdan korunmak için bir köprünün altına sığındık.

examples.en: She adopted a dog from the animal shelter.
Everyone needs food, water and shelter.
examples.tr: Herkesin yiyeceğe, suya ve barınağa ihtiyacı var.

senses.label: give out light
senses.definitionEn: to give out or reflect bright light

examples.en: The sun is shining, let's go to the park.
Her eyes shone with happiness.
Can you shine your torch over here?

senses.label: bright and reflecting light
senses.definitionEn: having a smooth bright surface that reflects light

examples.en: He bought a pair of shiny black shoes.
examples.tr: Bir çift parlak siyah ayakkabı aldı.

examples.en: The new car looked shiny and clean.
examples.tr: Yeni araba parlak ve temiz görünüyordu.

examples.en: This shampoo makes your hair soft and shiny.
examples.tr: Bu şampuan saçını yumuşak ve parlak yapar.

senses.label: large boat
senses.definitionEn: a large boat that carries people or goods across the sea

examples.en: The ship left the port early in the morning.
They travelled to Greece by ship.
There were over two thousand passengers on the ship.
examples.tr: Gemide iki binden fazla yolcu vardı.

senses.label: send goods
senses.definitionEn: to send goods to customers, often by post or transport

examples.en: We ship all orders within two days.
examples.tr: Tüm siparişleri iki gün içinde kargoluyoruz.

examples.en: Your package was shipped yesterday.

senses.label: sending goods
senses.definitionEn: the activity or cost of sending goods from one place to another

examples.en: The shop offers free shipping on orders over 500 lira.
examples.tr: Mağaza 500 lira üstü siparişlerde ücretsiz kargo sunuyor.

examples.en: How much are the shipping costs to Ankara?
He works for a large shipping company.

senses.label: piece of clothing
senses.definitionEn: a piece of clothing for the upper body, usually with buttons and a collar

examples.en: I need to iron my shirt before the interview.
He was wearing a blue shirt and jeans.
examples.tr: Mavi bir gömlek ve kot pantolon giyiyordu.

examples.en: This shirt is too small for me.

senses.label: sudden upsetting surprise
senses.definitionEn: a sudden unpleasant surprise, or the feeling it causes

examples.en: The news of his accident was a terrible shock.
It came as a shock when the factory closed.
examples.noteTr: come as a shock: şok etkisi yaratmak.

examples.en: She was still in shock after the earthquake.

senses.label: electricity through the body
senses.definitionEn: a sudden painful feeling caused by electricity passing through your body

examples.en: Don't touch that wire or you'll get a shock.
examples.tr: O kabloya dokunma, yoksa elektrik çarpar.

examples.en: I got a small shock from the old lamp.

commonMistakesTr: Duyguyu anlatırken 'I am shocking' demek; kişi hissediyorsa 'I am shocked', olay şok ediciyse 'It is shocking'.

senses.label: very surprised and upset
senses.definitionEn: feeling very surprised and upset because of something unexpected

examples.en: We were shocked by the high prices.
I was shocked to hear that they had split up.
Why do you look so shocked?

senses.label: covering for the foot
senses.definitionEn: something you wear on your foot, usually made of leather or plastic

examples.en: Please take off your shoes at the door.
I bought a new pair of running shoes.
examples.tr: Yeni bir çift koşu ayakkabısı aldım.
examples.noteTr: a pair of shoes: bir çift ayakkabı.

examples.en: Where is my other shoe?

senses.label: fire a weapon or kick at goal
senses.definitionEn: to fire a gun or arrow, or to kick or throw a ball towards the goal

examples.en: He shot from far away and scored a goal.
examples.tr: Uzaktan şut çekti ve gol attı.

examples.en: The hunter shot at the bird but missed.
examples.tr: Avcı kuşa ateş etti ama ıskaladı.

examples.en: Our team needs to shoot more often.
examples.tr: Takımımızın daha sık şut çekmesi gerekiyor.

senses.label: film or photograph
senses.definitionEn: to make a film or take photographs

examples.en: They are shooting a new film in our street.
The music video was shot in Cappadocia.

senses.label: firing guns or filming
senses.definitionEn: the act of firing a gun, or the process of making a film

examples.en: Shooting for the series will begin in May.
Look, a shooting star! Make a wish!
examples.tr: Bak, kayan yıldız! Bir dilek tut!

examples.en: The police heard shooting near the old factory.
examples.tr: Polis eski fabrikanın yakınında silah sesleri duydu.

senses.label: place that sells things
senses.definitionEn: a building or room where you can buy things

examples.en: Is there a shop near here that sells bread?
examples.tr: Buralarda ekmek satan bir dükkan var mı?

examples.en: She works as a shop assistant on Saturdays.
The shop closes at eight in the evening.

senses.label: buy things
senses.definitionEn: to go to shops to buy things

examples.en: I usually shop for food on Fridays.
examples.tr: Genellikle cuma günleri yiyecek alışverişi yaparım.

examples.en: We shopped all day and spent too much.
examples.tr: Bütün gün alışveriş yaptık ve çok harcadık.

commonMistakesTr: 'Go to shopping' demek yanlış; doğrusu 'go shopping'.

senses.label: buying things
senses.definitionEn: the activity of going to shops and buying things

examples.en: Let's go shopping on Saturday.
I do the shopping, and my husband cooks.
examples.tr: Alışverişi ben yaparım, eşim yemek pişirir.

examples.en: Don't forget the shopping list!

senses.label: land next to water
senses.definitionEn: the land along the edge of a sea or lake

examples.en: We walked along the shore at sunset.
The boat was too far from the shore.
They built a small house on the shore of the lake.
examples.tr: Gölün kıyısında küçük bir ev yaptılar.

grammarNoteTr: be short of something: bir şeyden az olmak (short of money)

senses.label: small in length or time
senses.definitionEn: small in length, height or time

examples.en: She has short black hair.
It's only a short walk to the station.
My brother is shorter than me.

senses.label: not enough of something
senses.definitionEn: a situation where there is not enough of something people need

examples.en: There is a shortage of nurses in many hospitals.
The summer heat caused a water shortage.
examples.tr: Yaz sıcağı su kıtlığına neden oldu.

examples.en: Food shortages are a serious problem after wars.
examples.tr: Yiyecek kıtlıkları savaşlardan sonra ciddi bir sorundur.

commonMistakesTr: 'Shortly' kelimesini 'kısaca' sanmak; 'kısaca' için briefly / in short kullanılır.

senses.label: soon
senses.definitionEn: in a short time; soon

examples.en: The train will arrive shortly.
She left shortly after the meeting started.
examples.tr: Toplantı başladıktan kısa süre sonra ayrıldı.

examples.en: Please wait, the manager will be with you shortly.
examples.tr: Lütfen bekleyin, müdür birazdan yanınızda olacak.

senses.label: kick, throw or attempt
senses.definitionEn: an act of kicking or throwing a ball towards a goal, or an attempt to do something

examples.en: That was a great shot from the edge of the box!
examples.tr: Ceza sahası çizgisinden harika bir şuttu!

examples.en: I've never tried surfing, but I'll give it a shot.
examples.tr: Hiç sörf yapmadım ama bir deneyeceğim.

examples.en: He heard a shot from the forest.

senses.label: photograph
senses.definitionEn: a photograph or a short part of a film

examples.en: She took some beautiful shots of the sunset.
examples.tr: Gün batımının çok güzel fotoğraflarını çekti.

examples.en: The opening shot shows the whole city.

senses.label: top of the arm
senses.definitionEn: the part of your body between your neck and the top of your arm

examples.en: She carried her bag on her shoulder.
My shoulders hurt after sitting at the computer all day.
examples.tr: Bütün gün bilgisayar başında oturunca omuzlarım ağrıdı.

examples.en: He just shrugged his shoulders and said nothing.
examples.tr: Sadece omuz silkti ve hiçbir şey söylemedi.

grammarNoteTr: shout at (kızgınlıkla), shout to (uzaktaki birine duyurmak için)

senses.label: say very loudly
senses.definitionEn: to say something very loudly

examples.en: Please don't shout, I can hear you.
The teacher never shouts at her students.
He shouted for help when he fell into the river.

commonMistakesTr: 'Duş almak' için 'make a shower' demek; doğrusu 'have/take a shower'.

senses.label: washing under water
senses.definitionEn: a device that sprays water on your body, or the act of washing this way

examples.en: I have a shower every morning.
He's in the shower right now, can he call you back?
examples.tr: Şu anda duşta, seni geri arayabilir mi?

examples.en: The shower in our hotel room didn't work.

grammarNoteTr: shut - shut - shut; 'Shut up!' kaba bir ifadedir

senses.label: close
senses.definitionEn: to close something, or to become closed

examples.en: Please shut the door when you leave.
The shops shut early on Sundays.
Shut your eyes and make a wish.
examples.tr: Gözlerini kapat ve bir dilek tut.

senses.label: ill
senses.definitionEn: not well; having an illness, or feeling that you may vomit

examples.en: I can't come to work today because I'm sick.
I feel sick after eating so much cake.
examples.tr: Bu kadar pasta yedikten sonra midem bulanıyor.

examples.en: Her mother looked after her when she was sick.

senses.label: bored with
senses.definitionEn: bored or annoyed because something has happened too often

examples.en: I'm sick of eating pasta every night.
Aren't you sick of this rainy weather?

commonMistakesTr: sight (görüş) ile site (yer, internet sitesi) karıştırılır; telaffuzları aynıdır.

senses.label: ability to see or view
senses.definitionEn: the ability to see, or something that you see

examples.en: My grandfather has poor sight and needs glasses.
examples.tr: Dedemin görme yeteneği zayıf ve gözlüğe ihtiyacı var.

examples.en: They fell in love at first sight.
We spent the day seeing the sights of Rome.
examples.tr: Günü Roma'nın görülecek yerlerini gezerek geçirdik.
examples.noteTr: see the sights: turistik yerleri gezmek.

commonMistakesTr: İmza (isim) için 'sign' demek; 'Can I have your signature?' doğrudur, 'sign' fiildir.

senses.label: notice or symbol
senses.definitionEn: a board with words or a symbol, or something that shows something exists

examples.en: The sign says no parking after six.
examples.tr: Tabelada altıdan sonra park yasak yazıyor.

examples.en: Dark clouds are a sign of rain.
She is learning sign language.

senses.label: write your name
senses.definitionEn: to write your name on a document

examples.en: Please sign here at the bottom of the page.
examples.tr: Lütfen sayfanın altına, buraya imza atın.

examples.en: Both sides signed the agreement yesterday.
examples.tr: İki taraf da anlaşmayı dün imzaladı.

senses.label: sign or radio wave
senses.definitionEn: a sound, movement or electronic wave that sends a message or information

examples.en: There's no phone signal in the mountains.
The referee gave the signal to start the game.
examples.tr: Hakem oyunu başlatmak için işaret verdi.

examples.en: Wait for the green signal before you cross.
examples.tr: Karşıya geçmeden önce yeşil ışığı bekle.

senses.label: your written name
senses.definitionEn: your name written in your own special way, for example on a document

examples.en: We need your signature on this form.
They collected thousands of signatures to save the park.
examples.tr: Parkı kurtarmak için binlerce imza topladılar.

examples.en: Kebab is the signature dish of this restaurant.
examples.noteTr: signature dish: imza yemeği, en ünlü yemek.

senses.label: in a large or important way
senses.definitionEn: by a large amount, or in a way that is important

examples.en: Sales have increased significantly this year.
examples.tr: Satışlar bu yıl önemli ölçüde arttı.

examples.en: The new route is significantly shorter.
examples.tr: Yeni güzergah kayda değer şekilde daha kısa.

examples.en: The two groups did not differ significantly.
examples.tr: İki grup arasında anlamlı bir fark yoktu.

senses.label: no sound
senses.definitionEn: a state when there is no sound or nobody speaks

examples.en: We ate our dinner in silence.
A loud phone broke the silence in the library.
examples.tr: Yüksek sesli bir telefon kütüphanedeki sessizliği bozdu.

examples.en: I love the silence of the early morning.
examples.tr: Sabahın erken saatlerindeki sessizliği çok severim.

senses.label: without sound
senses.definitionEn: without any sound, or not speaking

examples.en: The room went silent when the teacher came in.
Please put your phones on silent.
The 'k' in 'knife' is a silent letter.

senses.label: smooth soft cloth
senses.definitionEn: a soft smooth cloth made from threads produced by a small insect

examples.en: She bought a silk scarf for her mother.
Bursa has been famous for silk for centuries.
This dress is made of pure silk.

senses.label: not sensible
senses.definitionEn: not serious or sensible; a little stupid in a harmless way

examples.en: Don't be silly, of course you can stay with us.
Sorry, this might be a silly question.
examples.tr: Pardon, bu saçma bir soru olabilir.

examples.en: I felt silly wearing a costume to the party.
examples.tr: Partiye kostümle gidince kendimi aptal gibi hissettim.

senses.label: shiny grey metal
senses.definitionEn: a valuable shiny grey-white metal used for jewellery and coins

examples.en: He gave her a silver ring for her birthday.
examples.tr: Doğum gününde ona gümüş bir yüzük verdi.

examples.en: Our team won the silver medal.
My grandmother's old spoons are made of silver.

senses.label: in the same way
senses.definitionEn: in almost the same way; also used to add a point that is like the last one

examples.en: The twins always dress similarly.
Prices rose in Spain. Similarly, they went up in Italy.
examples.tr: İspanya'da fiyatlar arttı. Benzer şekilde İtalya'da da yükseldi.
examples.noteTr: Cümle başında bağlaç gibi: Benzer şekilde,

examples.en: The two phones are similarly priced.

senses.label: just; in an easy way
senses.definitionEn: only or just; also in a way that is easy to understand

examples.en: I simply don't have time to cook tonight.
examples.tr: Bu akşam yemek yapmaya gerçekten vaktim yok.

examples.en: Can you explain it more simply?
The view from the top was simply amazing.
examples.tr: Tepeden manzara kelimenin tam anlamıyla muhteşemdi.

commonMistakesTr: 'Samimi' Türkçede 'yakın/arkadaşça' anlamında da kullanılır; bu anlamda 'friendly' veya 'close' demek gerekir, 'sincere' değil.

senses.label: honest and real
senses.definitionEn: showing feelings that are honest and real

examples.en: Please accept our sincere thanks for your help.
examples.tr: Yardımınız için içten teşekkürlerimizi kabul edin.

examples.en: She seemed sincere when she said sorry.
He is a kind and sincere person.
examples.tr: O, nazik ve içten bir insan.

senses.label: in an honest way
senses.definitionEn: in a way that shows what you really feel

examples.en: I sincerely hope you feel better soon.
We sincerely apologise for the delay.
You can end a formal letter with Yours sincerely.

senses.label: make music with your voice
senses.definitionEn: to make musical sounds with your voice

examples.en: My little daughter loves to sing in the bath.
examples.tr: Küçük kızım banyoda şarkı söylemeyi çok sever.

examples.en: We sang happy birthday to our teacher.
Can you sing this song in English?

senses.label: person who sings
senses.definitionEn: a person who sings, especially as a job

examples.en: Who is your favourite singer?
She is the lead singer in a rock band.
The singer thanked the audience at the end.

senses.label: only one
senses.definitionEn: only one; used to emphasise one thing

examples.en: I'd like a single room for two nights.
examples.tr: İki gece için tek kişilik oda istiyorum.

examples.en: She practises the piano every single day.
There wasn't a single cloud in the sky.
examples.tr: Gökyüzünde tek bir bulut bile yoktu.

senses.label: not married
senses.definitionEn: not married or not in a romantic relationship

examples.en: Is your brother still single?
She raised two children as a single mother.
examples.tr: İki çocuğu bekar bir anne olarak büyüttü.

senses.label: basin for washing
senses.definitionEn: a bowl with taps in a kitchen or bathroom, used for washing

examples.en: Put the dirty plates in the sink.
The kitchen sink is blocked again.
Wash your hands at the sink before eating.

senses.label: go under water
senses.definitionEn: to go down below the surface of water

examples.en: The old boat sank in the storm.
Wood doesn't sink because it is light.

commonMistakesTr: 'Sir' soyadıyla kullanılmaz: 'Sir Yılmaz' değil 'Mr Yılmaz' denir.

senses.label: polite address to a man
senses.definitionEn: a polite way to speak to a man, especially a customer or someone senior

examples.en: Can I help you, sir?
Excuse me, sir, you dropped your wallet.
Start the email with 'Dear Sir or Madam'.

commonMistakesTr: İngilizcede 'abla' için ayrı kelime yoktur; 'older/big sister' denir.

senses.label: female sibling
senses.definitionEn: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you

examples.en: My older sister lives in Ankara.
Do you have any brothers or sisters?
examples.tr: Erkek ya da kız kardeşin var mı?

examples.en: I share a room with my little sister.
examples.tr: Küçük kız kardeşimle aynı odayı paylaşıyorum.

commonMistakesTr: Türkçedeki 'site' (konut sitesi) için 'housing complex' veya 'gated community' denir, 'site' değil.

senses.label: place used for something
senses.definitionEn: a place where something is, was or will be built or happens; also a website

examples.en: You must wear a helmet on the building site.
This is the site of an ancient Roman city.
examples.tr: Burası antik bir Roma şehrinin bulunduğu yer.

examples.en: I found the recipe on a cooking site.

senses.label: in a particular place
senses.definitionEn: in a particular place or position

examples.en: The hotel is situated near the old town.
examples.tr: Otel eski şehrin yakınında yer alıyor.

examples.en: Our office is conveniently situated next to the metro.
examples.tr: Ofisimiz uygun bir şekilde metronun yanında.

examples.en: The village is situated on top of a hill.

senses.label: what is happening
senses.definitionEn: the conditions and events at a particular time and place

examples.en: What would you do in my situation?
The economic situation is getting better.
We are in a difficult situation at work.

senses.label: trained and experienced
senses.definitionEn: having the training and experience to do a job well

examples.en: The company is looking for skilled workers.
She is highly skilled at fixing old furniture.
Making violins is skilled work.
examples.tr: Keman yapmak ustalık isteyen bir iştir.

senses.label: good at doing something
senses.definitionEn: able to do something very well

examples.en: He is a skillful driver even in heavy snow.
examples.tr: Yoğun karda bile becerikli bir sürücü.

examples.en: The team has many skillful young players.
examples.tr: Takımda pek çok yetenekli genç oyuncu var.

examples.en: Her skillful use of colour makes the painting special.
examples.tr: Rengi ustaca kullanması tabloyu özel kılıyor.

senses.label: outer layer of body or fruit
senses.definitionEn: the outer layer of a person's or animal's body, or of some fruit

examples.en: This cream is good for dry skin.
examples.tr: Bu krem kuru cilt için iyidir.

examples.en: Wear a hat to protect your skin from the sun.
examples.tr: Cildini güneşten korumak için şapka tak.

examples.en: Don't throw the banana skin on the ground.

senses.label: clothing from the waist
senses.definitionEn: a piece of clothing for women that hangs from the waist

examples.en: She wore a long red skirt to the wedding.
examples.tr: Düğüne uzun kırmızı bir etek giydi.

examples.en: This skirt is too tight for me.
Does this top go with my skirt?

senses.label: space above the earth
senses.definitionEn: the space above the earth where you can see the sun, moon and clouds

examples.en: The sky is clear and blue today.
We looked at the stars in the night sky.
Why is the sky red in the evening?

senses.label: wanting to sleep
senses.definitionEn: tired and wanting to sleep; also quiet with little activity

examples.en: I always feel sleepy after lunch.
examples.tr: Öğle yemeğinden sonra hep uykum gelir.

examples.en: The baby is sleepy, let's put her to bed.
They live in a sleepy little village by the sea.
examples.tr: Deniz kenarında sakin, küçük bir köyde yaşıyorlar.

senses.label: thin flat piece
senses.definitionEn: a thin flat piece cut from something like bread or cake

examples.en: Would you like another slice of cake?
examples.tr: Bir dilim daha pasta ister misin?

examples.en: I had two slices of toast for breakfast.
examples.tr: Kahvaltıda iki dilim kızarmış ekmek yedim.

examples.en: Cut the lemon into thin slices.

senses.label: move smoothly
senses.definitionEn: to move smoothly over a surface

examples.en: The kids slid down the snowy hill on a sledge.
The door slides open when you come close.
He slid the letter under the door.

senses.label: presentation page
senses.definitionEn: one page of a computer presentation

examples.en: I still need to finish the last two slides.
examples.tr: Son iki slaytı hâlâ bitirmem gerekiyor.

examples.en: Can you go back to the previous slide?

senses.label: a little
senses.definitionEn: a little; not very much

examples.en: I'm feeling slightly better today.
examples.tr: Bugün kendimi biraz daha iyi hissediyorum.

examples.en: The second version is slightly different.
Prices went up only slightly last month.
examples.tr: Geçen ay fiyatlar sadece hafifçe arttı.

senses.label: slide and almost fall
senses.definitionEn: to slide by accident and fall or almost fall

examples.en: Be careful not to slip on the wet floor.
She slipped on the ice and hurt her wrist.
examples.tr: Buzda ayağı kaydı ve bileğini incitti.

examples.en: Sorry, your birthday completely slipped my mind.
examples.tr: Üzgünüm, doğum günün tamamen aklımdan çıktı.

senses.label: ground going up or down
senses.definitionEn: a surface or piece of ground that goes up or down

examples.en: The house is built on a steep slope.
We spent the whole day on the ski slopes.
Grapes grow well on the sunny southern slopes.
examples.tr: Üzüm güneşli güney yamaçlarında iyi yetişir.

senses.label: intelligent
senses.definitionEn: intelligent and able to think quickly

examples.en: She is a very smart student.
That was a smart decision.
Our new fridge is smart and connects to the internet.
examples.tr: Yeni buzdolabımız akıllı ve internete bağlanıyor.

senses.label: well dressed
senses.definitionEn: clean, tidy and dressed in nice clothes

examples.en: You look very smart in that suit.
examples.tr: O takım elbiseyle çok şık görünüyorsun.

examples.en: Smart clothes are required at the dinner.

senses.label: phone like a small computer
senses.definitionEn: a mobile phone that can connect to the internet and run apps

examples.en: Almost everyone in my class has a smartphone.
examples.tr: Sınıfımdaki neredeyse herkesin akıllı telefonu var.

examples.en: I use my smartphone to pay for the bus.
examples.noteTr: use something to + fiil: ...mek için kullanmak.

examples.en: How many hours a day do you spend on your smartphone?
examples.tr: Akıllı telefonunda günde kaç saat geçiriyorsun?
